Job Summary

Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
Job Type: Full-Time. Experience: 6 Months - 1 Year.
We are looking for an innovative and enthusiastic AI Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about building AI-powered SaaS applications and intelligent agent-based systems. The ideal candidate should have experience in both frontend and backend development along with a strong understanding of AI integrations, automation workflows, and modern web technologies.


Responsibilities

Develop and maintain AI-powered SaaS applications and web platforms
Build intelligent agentic AI workflows using APIs, automation tools, and LLM integrations
Develop scalable frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, or similar frameworks
Build backend APIs and services using Python, Node.js, or FastAPI
Integrate AI models, chatbots, and third-party AI services such as OpenAI APIs
Work with databases, cloud platforms, and authentication systems
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality AI solutions
Participate in testing, deployment, and maintenance of applications


Required Skills

Good knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript
Experience with React.js, Next.js, or modern frontend frameworks
Understanding of backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Node.js
Familiarity with AI tools, APIs, and LLM integrations
Knowledge of REST APIs, authentication systems, and database management
Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Firebase, or similar databases
Basic understanding of cloud platforms and deployment workflows
Familiarity with Git/GitHub version control


Preferred Qualifications

Experience building AI chatbots, automation systems, or SaaS products
Understanding of prompt engineering and AI workflow orchestration
Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and AI agents is a plus
Experience with tools like LangChain, OpenAI, Pinecone, or Firebase is an advantage


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Roles & Responsibilities

Shape demand and executive conviction

Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.

Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins platform investments).

Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.

Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture

Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.

Set the non-functional bar and design to it latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.

Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.

Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it

Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.

Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.

Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over

Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.

Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.

Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.

Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice

Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.

Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.

Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

Must-have skills and experience

Architecture and platform depth

Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.

Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.

Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.

Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)

Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.

Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.

Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

Engineering craft (hands-on)

Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.

Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.

Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.

Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

Model provider and hyperscaler GenAI platform know-how

Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.

OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.

AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.

Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.

Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.

Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.

Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.

Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

Consultative and commercial ability

Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.

Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.

Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.

Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have

Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.

Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).

Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.

Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.

Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.

Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

Full-Stack App Developer

Company: HiWox
Position: Full-Stack App Developer
Engagement Type: Equity-Based Founding Team Role
Location: Remote/Hybrid
Commitment: Approximately 20-25 hours per week

About HiWox

HiWox is a HealthTech and personalized wellness intelligence company building a Healthcare Operating System (HOS) that integrates health data, analytics, evidence-based recommendations, and expert-validated wellness programs.

Our platform focuses on nine dimensions of wellness: Physical Fitness, Nutrition Metabolic Wellness, Mental Emotional Wellness, Sleep Recovery, Reproductive Hormonal Wellness, Financial Wellness, Digital Wellness, Occupational, Social Relationship Wellness, and Spiritual Wellness.

We aim to build an explainable, data-driven wellness ecosystem that collects information from users, smartphones, wearables, healthcare devices, clinical assessments, and lifestyle inputs to generate personalised insights, recommendations, rituals, reminders, and progress dashboards.

We are looking for a Full-Stack App Developer who can take ownership of mobile and backend development, build scalable application infrastructure, and help transform the HiWox vision into a reliable, user-friendly product.

Key Roles Responsibilities1. Mobile Application Development

Develop and maintain the HiWox mobile application, primarily using React Native or an appropriate cross-platform framework.

Build responsive, intuitive interfaces for onboarding, wellness assessments, data entry, dashboards, recommendations, rituals, reminders, and progress tracking.

Optimise app performance, accessibility, usability, and compatibility across Android devices.

2. Backend API Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services, REST APIs, business logic, and application integrations.

Build secure systems for user accounts, health profiles, assessments, wellness plans, notifications, and progress records.

Implement reliable authentication, authorisation, error handling, and API documentation.

3. Database Data Architecture

Design and maintain scalable database structures for user profiles, wellness parameters, historical records, assessments, and recommendation outputs.

Establish data validation, consistency, versioning, and efficient retrieval mechanisms.

Collaborate with data scientists and healthcare experts to structure data across HiWox s nine wellness dimensions.

4. Wellness Intelligence Algorithm Integration

Implement rule-based algorithms and recommendation workflows developed with domain experts.

Convert structured user inputs and validated rules into explainable wellness insights, recommendations, reminders, and personalised programs.

Build interfaces and backend services that allow algorithms to evolve without requiring major application redevelopment.

5. Wearable, Device Third-Party Integrations

Explore and implement integrations with smartphone sensors, wearables, rings, health platforms, and supported healthcare devices.

Integrate external APIs and data sources where access, technical compatibility, and user permissions allow.

Build data ingestion and validation workflows to handle missing, inconsistent, or delayed data.

6. Web Dashboards Operational Tools

Develop web-based dashboards and administrative interfaces for wellness assessments, user progress, partner operations, and program monitoring.

Support the HiWox Captain workflow for onboarding, follow-ups, evidence collection, and coordination with consultants.

Build appropriate access controls for users, internal teams, consultants, and partners.

7. Security, Privacy Reliability

Implement appropriate safeguards for sensitive health-related information, including access controls, secure transmission, and data protection practices.

Follow secure coding principles, maintain technical documentation, and support consent-based data access.

Conduct testing, resolve bugs, monitor application performance, and improve system reliability.

8. Product Development Technical Ownership

Collaborate with the founder, product team, data scientists, and healthcare experts to translate requirements into working features.

Participate in architecture decisions, sprint planning, code reviews, deployment, and release management.

Help establish a maintainable codebase, reusable design systems, automated testing, and a roadmap for future scalability.

Required Qualifications Experience

Bachelor s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building and maintaining mobile applications and backend systems.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native or a comparable mobile development framework.

Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Python, or equivalent frameworks.

Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases, API design, authentication, and application architecture.

Familiarity with Git, debugging, testing, deployment workflows, and software development best practices.

Ability to independently own features from requirement analysis through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building HealthTech, wellness, fitness, healthcare, or data-driven consumer applications.

Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, analytics, push notifications, and background processing.

Experience integrating wearables, smartphone sensors, healthcare APIs, or third-party platforms.

Knowledge of secure handling of sensitive personal and health-related data.

Experience building dashboards, configurable rule engines, or personalised recommendation systems.

Comfort working in an early-stage startup where requirements evolve and engineers contribute to product decisions.

Engagement Equity Structure

Equity-based role: No fixed salary is available at the current stage.

Commitment: Approximately 20-25 hours per week.

Work mode: Remote/hybrid, with coordination as required.

Equity participation: To be discussed based on technical expertise, responsibilities, contribution, and long-term commitment.

Vesting: A proposed five-year vesting structure to align team participation with sustained contribution and company growth.

Future compensation: Fixed compensation may be introduced after funding and revenue stabilisation. This could take 6-8 months or potentially a year, depending on business progress.

What You Will Build at HiWox

You will help build the technology foundation of a personalised wellness intelligence platform-not merely a standalone mobile application. Your work will connect mobile experiences, backend infrastructure, structured wellness data, explainable algorithms, device integrations, and operational dashboards into one integrated ecosystem.

We are looking for a technically strong, product-minded developer who is comfortable taking ownership, solving complex problems, and contributing to HiWox s long-term vision as a founding team member.
